itinerary.title: Kochi Arrival & Scenic Drive to Munnar Hills
activities: Airport/station pickup in private AC cab
Scenic waterfall stops along Neriamangalam route
itinerary.description: Warm welcome at Cochin International Airport (COK) or Ernakulam Junction. Enjoy a picturesque 4-hour drive climbing into the Western Ghats past Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check into your hillside cottage and relax with high-altitude fresh tea.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Gardens, Echo Point & Kundala Lake
activities: Morning visit to Echo Point & Kundala Lake
Tea museum & historic factory tasting walk
Sunset vantage point at Photo Point
itinerary.description: Wake up to misty green valleys. Explore Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake. Visit an authentic colonial tea processing factory and understand the journey from leaf to cup.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey Houseboat Backwater Cruise
activities: Freshly prepared candle-lit Kerala dinner under starry skies
itinerary.description: Descend the hills towards the tranquil backwaters of Alleppey. Board your traditional Kerala kettuvallam houseboat. Cruise through palm-fringed lagoons, paddy fields, and quiet canal hamlets while chef prepares fresh Karimeen fish curry and coconut rice.

itinerary.title: Morning Village Cruise & Departure via Kochi
activities: Drop-off at Cochin Airport / Railway Station
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast as morning prayers echo across the serene waterways. Disembark at 09:30 AM and transfer back to Kochi for heritage sightseeing in Fort Kochi (Chinese fishing nets) before your flight or train home.

important_instructions: Please carry light woollens for Munnar evenings (14°C - 18°C). Houseboat air conditioning operates from 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM in standard package.
cancellation_policy: 100% Free Cancellation up to 72 hours before arrival. Cancellations within 72 hours are subject to 1-night retention.

activities: Eravikulam wildlife safari with pre-booked passes
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Eravikulam National Park to witness the endangered Nilgiri Tahr mountain goats. Afternoon visit to top station vantage point.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady Cardamom Hills
itinerary.description: Scenic 3-hour hill drive to Thekkady (Periyar). Evening traditional Kalaripayattu martial arts show and spice market exploration.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Luxury Houseboat Villa
activities: Chef special multi-course traditional Sadya lunch
itinerary.description: Drive down to Alleppey backwaters. Board a premium air-conditioned houseboat villa with large glass observation deck. Evening Shikara excursion.

itinerary.title: Morning Waterside Serenity & Kochi Return
itinerary.description: Wake to bird calls over the misty waters. Disembark and visit Fort Kochi heritage streets and cafes before airport transfer.

tagline: Khardung La, turquoise Pangong Lake, Diskit Monastery, and Nubra dunes
description: An awe-inspiring expedition into the Trans-Himalayan wonderland of Ladakh. Cross the world's highest motorable passes, camp under starry skies by the cobalt waters of Pangong Tso, and witness the double-humped camels of Hunder.
accommodation_type: Deluxe Leh Hotel & Luxury Tented Camps at Pangong
pickup_drop: Leh Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport Pickup & Drop

itinerary.title: Leh Arrival & Mandatory Acclimatization
itinerary.description: Arrive at Leh airport (11,500 ft). Transfer to hotel for mandatory full-day rest to adjust to the thin mountain air. Gentle evening visit to Leh Market.

itinerary.title: Indus Valley Monasteries & Shanti Stupa
itinerary.description: Visit the iconic white-domed Shanti Stupa for panoramic valley views, followed by 14th-century Thiksey Monastery and Shey Palace.

itinerary.title: Khardung La to Nubra Valley Sand Dunes
itinerary.description: Drive across Khardung La Pass (17,982 ft) into the dramatic Nubra Valley. Visit the giant Maitreya Buddha statue at Diskit and the cold desert dunes of Hunder.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley to Mesmerizing Pangong Tso
itinerary.description: Journey along the wild Shyok River route to the world-renowned Pangong Tso Lake (14,270 ft). Witness the water shifting through shades of blue and emerald.

itinerary.title: Pangong Sunrise & Return to Leh via Chang La
itinerary.description: Catch a breathtaking sunrise over Pangong Lake before traversing Chang La pass back to Leh for a celebratory farewell evening.

itinerary.title: Departure from the Land of High Passes
itinerary.description: Morning transfer to Leh Airport for your return flight with unforgettable memories of the Himalayas.

important_instructions: Acclimatization is essential. Drink plenty of water and avoid strenuous physical effort on Day 1. Warm layers (down jacket, thermals, gloves) required.
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 15 days before departure date. 50% cancellation fee between 7–15 days.
